summary.ship_ready_pct_evidence: 26 engines/actions audited as SFC-critical: 17 SHIP-READY, 4 PARTIAL, 4 MISSING, 1 STUB. (17+0.5*4)/26 = 73% raw, but P0-gap-weighted (SFCCompositeResultEngine missing = critical product gap, GilbertEconomicSpeedEngine orphaned, MillingForceEngine stub blocking mill route, MaterialVariabilityResolver missing) reduces effective ship-ready to ~68%.
summary.days_to_ship_breakdown: P0 work (only path to paid SFC): 1d SFCCompositeResultEngine + dispatcher action, 1d MaterialVariabilityResolverEngine, 0.5d wire GilbertEconomicSpeedEngine to prism_calc:lathe_cost_optimize/mill_cost_optimize, 0.5d de-stub or re-route MillingForceEngine, 1d functional smoke test of sfc_calculate end-to-end against 6 ISO groups, 1d Fusion 360 round-trip integration test (already live bridge), 2d UX/copy/pricing-gate polish = 7d to paid v1. P1 (Mastercam bridge + SpindleCharacteristicEngine + CoolantDatabaseEngine) adds 5d for v1.1.
summary.verdict: AMBER — backend physics is 73% there but the buy-this-tomorrow PRODUCT surface (SFCCompositeResultEngine + MaterialVariabilityResolver) does NOT exist; the orchestration burden today lives in the caller. 7 days to ship v1 paid if focused on the 4 P0 items.
